summary: Item 1 (SWARM_V10_PLAN §1 / PLAN.md §1) implemented in src/components/viewer3d/PlaneHelpers.tsx (283 lines) + new gate scripts/verify/plane-helper-extent.mjs (854 lines). CHANGED: the three helper quads now span the WHOLE CLIP_BOUNDS rectangle of their two in-plane axes, DERIVED at runtime from CLIP_BOUNDS (viewer3d/clipPlanes.ts) with the shared AXIS_PAIR/AXIS_INDEX (section/planeGeometry.ts) - no extent literal anywhere in code: transverse x[-58,58] x z[-76,72], sagittal z[-76,72] x y[-55,116], coronal x[-58,58] x y[-55,116]; quad centres are the in-plane box midpoints (0, 30.5, -2); grid cells are a constant 4.0 au on both axes (GRID_CELL_AU=4 -> divisions round(extent/4): 29x37 / 37x43 / 29x43 cells, cell 4.000/3.977), not the pre-v10 fixed 20/24 lines. Because three's GridHelper takes ONE divisions value and is always square (it would coarsen the y cells and overhang the quad) the grid is the same lines built as a LineSegments in the quad's OWN local XY frame with the quad's rotation - one rotation per sheet, so quad and grid cannot desync. Unchanged visual contract: colour #38bdf8, opacity 0.07 quad / 0.22 grid, transparent, DoubleSide, depthWrite false, renderOrder 30/31, raycast disabled, group name 'clip-plane-helpers', and the store flag clip.showHelper still gates everything (false -> null). Cost: every geometry (quad args array + line BufferGeometry) is built ONCE per axis at module load; a slider drag only moves the group position (args/geometry object identity stable across renders, asserted). The pre-v10 shortfall fixed: the sagittal/coronal sheet was 71.0 au (85.2 mm) short of the vertex at y=+116 (68.7 au = 82.4 mm above the measured ribbon top +113.7), the transverse sheet missed 31 au posteriorly and 35 au anteriorly. VERIFIED: npm run check exit 0; node scripts/verify/plane-helper-extent.mjs exit 0 = 196 passed / 0 failed (per-axis table: quad WxH, measured world u/v rect, cells, grid vertices/lines, render orders, all printed); npm run verify:plane exit 0 (10827 assertions); also validated in a tree with base-HEAD versions of the five other in-flight files. The gate measures four lanes: (A) the shipped pure planeHelperGeometry(axis,value) derivation + the 2D-canvas cross-check against planeGeometry.axisExtents; (B) the SHIPPED component's render path is executed (project TypeScript transpile + repo Node hook; only the zustand store specifier is stubbed for the clip.showHelper selector) and its element tree walked - the quad's four corners and every grid vertex are transformed through the shipped rotation and must land on the CLIP_BOUNDS rectangle (1e-9 for doubles, 1e-4 au for the Float32 vertex buffer); motion/showHelper/material/renderOrder/raycast/identity asserted; (C) source code with comments AND string payloads stripped contains none of {96,82,100,48,45,41,56,26} nor the current bounds {58,116,76,72,55,30.5}, imports CLIP_BOUNDS from ./clipPlanes, builds exactly one BufferGeometry outside the render path; (D) THE BITE - clipPlanes.ts copied to gitignored scratch with x.max 58->70, y.max 116->130, z.min -76->-90, the copied PlaneHelpers re-imported: width 116->128 / 148->162, height 148->162 / 171->185, divisions 29->32 / 37->41 / 43->46, cells still ~4 au, shipped clipPlanes.ts + PlaneHelpers.tsx sha256 printed identical before/after (d4447170f9f9 / ad331150b97d). The gate itself was shown to bite: 4 in-place mutations of PlaneHelpers.tsx (pre-v10 quad literal 96 -> 165/28 failed; u/v pair swapped -> 150/43; fixed 24-line count -> 181/12; sagittal rotation dropped -> 184/9), file restored byte-identical (hash verified). DEVIATION FROM PLAN.md §1 (noted): PLAN specified gridHelper args [W,H,divisionsU,divisionsV]; three 0.169's GridHelper(size, divisions) accepts ONE divisions value and is always square, so that call cannot span 116x171 au with au-constant cells - implemented as an equivalent LineSegments grid in the quad's local frame (same material and spacing). npm script the integrator must add (package.json is the integrator's): "verify:plane-helper-extent": "node scripts/verify/plane-helper-extent.mjs". COULD NOT OBSERVE: Chrome cannot run in this sandbox, so the on-screen claim (the helper now covers the cortex, legibility at 43 lines) is orchestrator-only via verify:acceptance/verify:audit; lane B runs no reconciler and no WebGL. Other run gates at my final sweep: validate 0 err/0 warn, build exit 0, verify:pipeline, verify:audit-checks, verify:pip-contract, verify:closure-bite, verify:a11y-contract, verify:boundary-contract 22/22, verify:budget-report, verify:somatotopy 45/45, verify-imaging-v4, verify-imaging-v4b all exit 0.
